resources.string: A floating UP / DOWN / DNT signal checker for Binance.US spot markets. It reads public candles and never places trades.

Target-aware 15-minute decision system: at the start of every quarter-hour, automatically capture the BTC price from the opening of the new 15-minute Binance candle. That opening price is the binary target for the next 15 minutes. Predict whether BTC will finish above or below that exact starting price. At the next quarter-hour, capture a fresh target and repeat. No manually entered strike and no fixed-dollar buffer. The 1-minute chart detects local exhaustion, momentum divergence, volume expansion or drying, and structural breaks; 5-minute and 15-minute structure add confirmation. The Strictness slider scales the required confirmation count, score threshold, and volume validation from Loose / Aggressive to Ultra-Strict. Each qualifying signal opens a 60-second entry window. This is a manual decision aid, not financial advice or an automatic trader.
